options: Ms. Rebeca Gyumi only C FU
All three Ms. Joenia Wapichana, Ms. Asma Jahangir and Ms. Rebeca Gyumi
key_text: All three Ms. Joenia Wapichana, Ms. Asma Jahangir and Ms. Rebeca Gyumi
explanation:
Printed key: all three women (all were 2018 laureates). Strictly, only Rebeca Gyumi's citation is specifically for the rights of women and girls (aljazeera.com, 26 Oct 2018).
